personnel_and_control_gates.ihe_pi_and_senior_key: Required US-campus appointment at the deadline: tenure/tenure-track, primary full-time paid research/teaching, or qualifying OSPO/equivalent leadership; apply the stated institutional family/medical exception only with actual evidence.
personnel_and_control_gates.other_eligible_org_pi: Employee acting for the organization and normally resident in the US, subject to the stated temporary-abroad exception.
personnel_and_control_gates.location_and_work: Primary overseas appointments excluded as stated; funded personnel must have the legal right to work in the US for the relevant organization. This is not a claim that every activity must physically occur in the US.
personnel_and_control_gates.ownership_and_control: The solicitation's US nonprofit/for-profit control test includes greater-than-50% qualifying ownership and actual majority control. Application of equity wording to a nonstock nonprofit remains a question for the real applicant and NSF; 501(c)(3) recognition does not resolve it.
personnel_and_control_gates.research_security: Screen the real organization and personnel against applicable research-security restrictions; required training, disclosures and certifications are not established by this repository.
personnel_and_control_gates.foreign_affiliate_inquiry: A US affiliate/subsidiary of a foreign organization needs cognizant NSF inquiry before proposal preparation under PAPPG I.E.2; this does not waive the stricter PESOSE eligibility requirements.

operating_assessment.cash_and_overage: This is a restricted research-grant opportunity, not API credits or unrestricted sponsorship. Track caps are ceilings, not likely receipts. An approved actual budget must cover eligible work; no overrun subsidy, renewal entitlement, credit rollover or pre-award reimbursement is assumed.
operating_assessment.reporting: PAPPG VII generally requires annual reports at least 90 days before budget-period end, a final annual report and a public outcomes report within 120 days after award end. Actual award terms and reporting dates remain unestablished.
operating_assessment.public_outcomes_privacy: The public outcomes report is published verbatim: exclude confidential/proprietary material and personal information. Aggregate research outputs only after rights and privacy review; a public-repository license does not grant rights to participant or third-party material.
operating_assessment.publication_and_data: Current Supplement 2 requires PAR accepted-manuscript deposit by publication, replaces the old embargo and updates data/PID sharing. Justify needed exceptions in the DMSP; scope-changing plan revisions need prior written program-officer approval. No provider benchmark permission is inferred.
operating_assessment.branding: Award recipients must acknowledge actual NSF support under current branding instructions, including relevant publications/webpages and media. The logo cannot imply product endorsement or affiliation. No award, logo approval or NSF endorsement is established here.
operating_assessment.portability: An award belongs to the recipient's administration, not a contributor's account. PI/organization transfer requires both organizations and NSF, with formal approval and an eligible receiving arrangement. New subawards require prior NSF authorization; no host exit or later incorporation automatically transfers the award.
operating_assessment.renewal: Reassess the actual program, award, reporting and terms before an extension, new proposal or continued funding. An extension is not additional money; no automatic renewal is promised by the reviewed evidence.
operating_assessment.independence: Proposed internal controls: retain transparent methods and qualified negative results, disclose funding, avoid sponsor influence on rankings, document governance and custodial rights, and review any publication, indemnity or IP term before acceptance. These are project controls, not invented universal NSF clauses.
operating_assessment.award_terms_limit: The current official index lists July 31, 2026 GC-1; its PDF returned HTTP403 with no bytes. The applicable notice and complete current general/special conditions must be reviewed before accepting an award. HTML index and PAPPG review do not substitute for that missing document.
